import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import os

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from ./input
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define target and ID columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Prepare features
X = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col, id_col])
y = train_df[target_col]
train_ids = train_df[id_col]
test_ids = test_df[id_col]
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[id_col])

# Hold-out validation split (80/20) to prevent data leakage
n_samples = len(X)
indices = np.random.permutation(n_samples)
train_size = int(0.8 * n_samples)
train_idx = indices[:train_size]
val_idx = indices[train_size:]

X_train, y_train = X.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[train_idx]
X_val, y_val = X.iloc[val_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]

# Train LightGBM Classifier
# verbose=-1 to disable progress bars
# n_jobs=-1 to utilize all CPU cores efficiently
# n_estimators and num_leaves are set to reasonable defaults for a simple baseline
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    num_leaves=31,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
accuracy = (val_pred == y_val).mean()
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_pred})

# Save to submission/submission.csv
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
